name: Crescent Halal Butchers
description: Family-run halal butchers on Staniforth Road for over twenty years. Fresh lamb, beef and chicken daily, plus a full range of spices and store-cupboard staples. Bulk orders for walimas and aqiqahs welcome — please give 48 hours' notice.

name: Noor Tuition Centre
description: After-school and weekend tuition in maths, English and science for Years 3 to 11, plus GCSE revision intensives. Small groups, DBS-checked tutors, and separate sessions for boys and girls.

name: Safar Travel & Hajj Services
description: ATOL-protected Hajj and Umrah packages departing from Manchester, with group leaders from Sheffield. Also general flight booking and visa assistance. Drop into the office on Abbeydale Road or call for a quote.

name: Barakah Grocers
description: Fresh fruit and vegetables, South Asian and Middle Eastern groceries, and a bakery counter stocked daily. Open until 10pm every night, later through Ramadan.

name: Hikmah Legal Advice
description: Immigration, family and housing law from a small local practice. Free 20-minute initial consultation for members of the community, and appointments available on Saturday mornings.
